## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the motivation behind them. Reference any related issues using keywords like `Closes #123` or `Fixes #456`.

Closes #

## Type of Change

Select the type of change this PR introduces:

- [ ] **feat** — New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] **fix** — Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] **docs** — Documentation only
- [ ] **style** — Code style changes (formatting, whitespace, etc.)
- [ ] **refactor** — Code refactoring (no functional changes)
- [ ] **test** — Adding or updating tests
- [ ] **chore** — Build process, dependencies, or tooling
- [ ] **perf** — Performance improvement
- [ ] **db** — Database schema or migration change

## Breaking Change

- [ ] Yes, this introduces a breaking change
- [ ] No, this is backwards compatible

## Checklist

Before requesting a review, ensure the following:

- [ ] My code follows the project's TypeScript and Tailwind conventions
- [ ] I have run `npm run lint` and fixed any issues
- [ ] I have run `npm run typecheck` and fixed any issues
- [ ] I have run `npm test` and all tests pass
- [ ] I have added tests for new functionality (if applicable)
- [ ] My changes do not introduce new warnings or errors
- [ ] I have updated the documentation (if applicable)
- [ ] I have verified UI changes in both light and dark mode
- [ ] My commits follow the Conventional Commits specification
- [ ] My branch is rebased on the latest `main` (no merge commits)

## Screenshots / Screen Recordings

If your PR includes UI changes, please attach screenshots or recordings showing the before and after.

## Additional Notes

Add any other information that might be helpful during review (e.g., design decisions, performance considerations, edge cases handled).
